headlines.description: — Fraser Minten had a goal and two assists, Pavel Zacha scored his first goal of the season and the Boston Bruins beat the struggling Philadelphia Flyers 5-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fraser Minten has a goal and two assists as Bruins roll past winless Flyers 5-1

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Nico Hischier scored two goals and added an assist while Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist in the New Jersey Devils' 4-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nico Hischier has 2 goals and an assist to help the Devils roll to a 4-1 win over the Canucks

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid recorded his 13th point of the season and 10th assist as the Edmonton Oilers beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Saturday for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid posts 10th assist as Oilers beat Sharks 3-1 for 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov had three goals and an assist, Matt Boldy scored his first goal of the season in the game's first minute, and the Minnesota Wild spoiled Florida's home opener by...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov has 4-point night, Wild top Panthers 4-1 to spoil Florida's home opener

headlines.description: — John Marino, Anders Lee and Kailer Yamamoto each had a goal and an assist to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth bounce back to beat the Sabres 4-1 to close trip

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored in the sixth round of a shootout, Jacob Fowler made 30 saves and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Detroit Red Wings 1-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bolduc scores in shootout as the Canadiens outlast the Red Wings 1-0

headlines.description: — Shane Pinto scored the shootout winner to give the Ottawa Senators a 3-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators rally to beat the Predators 3-2 in shootout

headlines.description: — Rickard Rakell scored the deciding goal in the shootout and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rickard Rakell scores in shootout to lift Penguins over Stars, 2-1

headlines.description: — Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook had a goal and an assist each and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook have a goal and an assist each as Hurricanes top Blackhawks 5-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud scored twice and Dylan Holloway had three assists as the St. Louis Blues beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Snuggerud, Holloway lift Blues to 5-3 victory over Blue Jackets

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — William Nylander and Easton Cowan scored 46 seconds apart late in the second period and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nylander ties a career high with 5 points, Maple Leafs beat Avs, 6-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel scored two goals with less than two minutes to play to complete his hat trick and the Tampa Bay Lightning extended their winning streak to four games with a 5-3 victory over the New York Islanders on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hagel completes hat trick with 2 late goals as Lightning beat Islanders 5-3

headlines.description: — Ryan Poehling broke a tie with a short-handed goal at 5:35 of the third period, but was injured on the play in the Anaheim Ducks' 4-2 victory over the winless Calgary Flames on Saturday night to start a home-and-home series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks beat the winless Flames 4-2 in Calgary to start a home-and-home series

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Mitch Marner scored a power-play goal from the high slot at 2:41 of overtime to give Vegas a 2-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday on a night in which the Golden Knights paid tribute to their past.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marner scores on OT power play to lift the Golden Knights past the Kings, 2-1
